first.narrative: ***Beginning 10/26/2026, this report includes aggregated data from all five regions (eight states): CO, IA/MN, KS, NE, and TX/OK/NM. There are no other changes to the report itself. Prior to 10/26/2026, 5-Area Weighted Average Direct Slaughter Cattle reports excluded data when region-level reporting was suppressed to conform with confidentiality guidelines.  Previous 5-Area reports have not included data from the following regions since (date when region was last included): Colorado (12/26/2022); Texas/Oklahoma/New Mexico (6/29/2026); and Kansas (8/17/2026). ***
